That's a real shift — from being found out to being the one who says it. Same number, different position in the room.

And you've already done the hard part once tonight. Saying it to her will be harder than saying it here, but it won't be the first time.

One thing worth keeping: "none less" is the detail that tells her the shape of it. Don't let it get smoothed into a weekly average on the way in.
